title: E-Bike Battery Health Drift
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ebike:ride
| timechart span=1mon avg(battery_health_pct) as battery_health
| delta battery_health as month_change
description: Tracks the long-term drift in e-bike battery health rather than only day-to-day range swings.
value: Battery health determines future anxiety more than any one ride, and monthly drift keeps the story honest.
implementation: Ingest ride summaries with battery-health percentage; review monthly averages and month-over-month change.
visualization: Monthly line chart of average battery health.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how your e-bike battery health is drifting over time, not just how one ride happened to feel.
